ui.i18n.text_unavailable: Neutral placeholder rendered instead of a missing key; never replace it with the key itself.
ui.i18n.language: Label of the language selector on the login screen and in the account menu.
ui.i18n.saved: Toast shown after the user language preference is saved.
ui.i18n.save_failed: Toast shown when the language preference cannot be saved.
ui.common.accept: Generic affirmative action in confirmations and dialogs.
ui.common.cancel: Generic dismissal action that discards the pending change.
ui.common.close: Generic close action for dialogs, panels and popovers.
ui.common.save: Generic persist action for forms and editors.
ui.common.delete: Generic destructive action, usually requiring confirmation.
ui.login.title: Heading of the sign-in screen.
ui.login.password_placeholder: Masked placeholder of the password field.
ui.login.show_password: Accessible name of the button that reveals the password.
ui.login.hide_password: Accessible name of the button that masks the password again.
ui.login.submit: Submit button of the sign-in form while idle.
ui.login.submitting: Submit button of the sign-in form while the request is in flight.
ui.login.error_username_required: Field error when the username is empty.
ui.login.error_password_required: Field error when the password is empty.
ui.login.error_required: Form error when both credentials are missing.
ui.login.error_invalid: Form error for a rejected username or password.
ui.login.error_unavailable: Form error when the sign-in request cannot reach the server.
ui.login.error_in_progress: Returned when a login submit is attempted while the previous one is still running.
ui.shell.skip_link: Skip link that jumps to the main content region.
ui.shell.nav_aria: Accessible name of the main sidebar navigation landmark.
ui.shell.nav_open: Accessible name of the button that opens the sidebar drawer.
ui.shell.nav_close: Accessible name of the button that closes the sidebar drawer.
ui.shell.nav_sections: Accessible name of the navigation list that groups sections.
ui.shell.workspace: Sidebar group label above the section links.
ui.shell.brand_subtitle: Small subtitle under the product name in the sidebar brand.
ui.shell.crumb_aria: Accessible name of the breadcrumb that shows the current page.
ui.shell.extensions: Sidebar group label above extension pages.
ui.shell.categories: Sidebar group label above the asset categories.
ui.shell.account_aria: Accessible name of the account popover menu.
ui.shell.user_fallback: Placeholder shown when no signed-in user is available.
ui.shell.role_none: Fallback shown when the current user has no role.
ui.shell.open_config: Account menu action that opens the settings section.
ui.shell.logout: Account menu action that ends the session.
ui.shell.logout_failed: Toast shown when the server did not confirm the logout request.
ui.shell.search_trigger: Visible label of the universal search trigger.
ui.shell.search_aria: Accessible name of the universal search trigger; {app} is the product name.
ui.shell.prealpha: Chip that marks the build maturity in the top bar.
ui.shell.sidebar_pin: Accessible name of the sidebar pin button when the sidebar is free.
ui.shell.sidebar_pinned: Tooltip of the sidebar pin button when the sidebar is pinned.
ui.shell.theme_light: Accessible name of the theme toggle while the dark theme is active.
ui.shell.theme_dark: Accessible name of the theme toggle while the light theme is active.
ui.shell.theme_light_label: Visible theme toggle label for the light theme.
ui.shell.theme_dark_label: Visible theme toggle label for the dark theme.
ui.shell.server_data_title: Sidebar note title when the shell reads server data.
ui.shell.server_data_body: Sidebar note body that lists the server-backed areas.
ui.shell.demo_data_title: Sidebar note title when only demo data is available.
ui.shell.demo_data_body: Sidebar note body that states demo persistence limits.
ui.shell.demo_mode: Marker of a demonstration installation in the top bar.
ui.shell.demo_restart_pending: Demo countdown label while the restart time is not known yet.
ui.shell.demo_restart_unknown: Demo countdown label when the restart endpoint is unavailable.
ui.shell.demo_restart_in: Demo countdown label; {time} is the remaining minutes and seconds.
ui.shell.language_selector: Accessible name of every interface language selector.
ui.shell.result_count: Pluralized count of search results; uses {count} for the plural form.
ui.nav.conversation: Sidebar link to the assistant conversation.
ui.nav.infrastructure: Sidebar link to the infrastructure map and graph.
ui.nav.data: Sidebar link to import and export.
ui.nav.people: Sidebar link to the people directory.
ui.nav.help: Sidebar link to the help page.
ui.page.panel: Breadcrumb and document title for the dashboard route.
ui.page.inventory: Breadcrumb and document title for the inventory route.
ui.page.conversation: Breadcrumb and document title for the conversation route.
ui.page.maintenance: Breadcrumb and document title for maintenance and incident routes.
ui.page.monitoring: Breadcrumb and document title for the monitoring route.
ui.page.infrastructure: Breadcrumb and document title for the map and graph routes.
ui.page.data: Breadcrumb and document title for the import and export route.
ui.page.reports: Breadcrumb and document title for the reports route.
ui.page.warranties: Breadcrumb and document title for the warranties route.
ui.page.labels: Breadcrumb and document title for the labels route.
ui.page.report_asset: Breadcrumb and document title for a single asset report.
ui.page.people: Breadcrumb and document title for the people route.
ui.page.users: Breadcrumb and document title for user administration.
ui.page.user: Breadcrumb and document title fallback for a single user.
ui.page.denied: Breadcrumb and document title for the access-denied screen.
ui.page.notifications: Breadcrumb and document title for the notifications route.
ui.page.settings: Breadcrumb and document title for the settings route.
ui.page.help: Breadcrumb and document title for the help route.
ui.page.extension: Breadcrumb and document title fallback for an extension page.
ui.page.login: Document title of the sign-in screen.
ui.page.device: Breadcrumb fallback for a monitored device without an identifier.
ui.page.alert: Breadcrumb fallback for a monitoring alert without an identifier.
ui.errors.unauthorized: Error shown when the server rejects an expired or missing session.
ui.errors.forbidden: Error shown when the caller lacks the required permission.
ui.errors.conflict: Error shown when the current state blocks the operation.
ui.errors.validation_error: Error shown when the server rejects submitted fields.
ui.errors.not_found: Error shown when the requested record does not exist.
ui.errors.rate_limited: Error shown when the server throttles the request.
ui.errors.too_many_requests: Error shown when the daily token quota of an external engine is exhausted.
ui.errors.unavailable: Error shown when an external engine is not reachable.
ui.errors.request_failed: Fallback error for an unmapped failure code.
ui.errors.request_rejected: Error header for a rejected request; {reason} carries the server reason.
ui.errors.field_invalid: Inline field error for a rejected form value.
ui.errors.cancelled: Error used when a request was aborted by the client.
ui.errors.session_unavailable: Error used when the session envelope is missing or inactive.
ui.errors.stream_unavailable: Error used when the server does not return an event stream.
